name: 连接数/连接池诊断
description: PostgreSQL 采用进程模型（每连接一个后端进程），连接成本高（fork 进程 + 分配内存约 5-10MB/连接）。当连接数接近 max_connections、空闲连接过多、或连接创建销毁频繁时，会导致内存浪费、进程管理开销、以及 FATAL: too many connections 错误。连接池（PgBouncer/Pgpool-II）是 PostgreSQL 生产环境的必备组件。

signals.desc: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already / FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
大量连接处于 idle 状态且持续时间长
短时间内大量连接创建和销毁（pg_stat_database 的 numbackends 波动剧烈）

conditions.desc: 当前连接数超过 max_connections 的 80%
空闲连接占总连接数 50% 以上
日志出现连接数超限错误

skip_when.desc: 连接数 < max_connections 的 50% 且 idle 连接 < 20%
已使用连接池且 max_connections 有足够余量

root_causes.name: 未使用连接池
root_causes.desc: 应用直连 PostgreSQL，每个应用实例/线程独占一个数据库连接。微服务架构下几十个服务各自建立连接池，连接数爆炸式增长。PostgreSQL 的进程模型不适合直接处理数百个连接。

root_causes.name: 连接泄漏
root_causes.desc: 应用获取连接后未正确释放（异常路径未 close、ORM 连接池配置错误、连接被 GC 回收但数据库端未感知）。表现为 idle 连接持续增长且不回收，最终耗尽 max_connections。

root_causes.name: max_connections 设置不当
root_causes.desc: max_connections 设太低无法满足峰值需求，或设太高（如 1000+）导致大量进程竞争 CPU 和内存。PostgreSQL 官方建议有效并发不超过 CPU 核数的 2-4 倍，超出部分应由连接池排队。

root_causes.name: 连接池配置不当
root_causes.desc: 已部署 PgBouncer 但配置不当：pool_mode=session 等于没有池化、default_pool_size 过大、server_idle_timeout 过长导致连接不回收、reserve_pool_size=0 无法应对突发。

root_causes.name: 连接频繁创建销毁（churn）
root_causes.desc: 应用使用短连接模式（每个请求建立+关闭连接），fork 进程的开销在高并发下显著。即使连接数未达上限，频繁的连接/断连也消耗大量 CPU 和内存。

step1_connection_overview.desc: 连接数概览：总数、活跃、空闲、等待
step1_connection_overview.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active') AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle') AS idle, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle in transaction') AS idle_in_txn, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state IS NULL) AS backend_other, current_setting('max_connections')::int AS max_conn, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / current_setting('max_connections')::int * 100, 1) AS used_pct FROM pg_stat_activity

step2_connection_by_source.desc: 按应用/用户/数据库分组查看连接来源
step2_connection_by_source.sql: SELECT usename, datname, application_name, client_addr, COUNT(*) AS connections, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active') AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle') AS idle, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle in transaction') AS idle_in_txn FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' GROUP BY usename, datname, application_name, client_addr ORDER BY connections DESC LIMIT 20

step3_long_idle_connections.desc: 找出长时间空闲的连接（潜在泄漏）
step3_long_idle_connections.sql: SELECT pid, usename, datname, application_name, client_addr, state, backend_start, state_change, now() - state_change AS idle_duration FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle' AND now() - state_change > interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY state_change LIMIT 20

step4_connection_age.desc: 查看连接的年龄分布（识别连接复用情况）
step4_connection_age.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN now() - backend_start < interval '1 minute' THEN '< 1 min' WHEN now() - backend_start < interval '10 minutes' THEN '1-10 min' WHEN now() - backend_start < interval '1 hour' THEN '10-60 min' WHEN now() - backend_start < interval '1 day' THEN '1-24 hours' ELSE '> 24 hours' END AS age_bucket, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(now() - backend_start)

step5_connection_settings.sql: SELECT name, setting, unit, short_desc FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('max_connections', 'superuser_reserved_connections', 'reserved_connections', 'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout', 'idle_session_timeout', 'tcp_keepalives_idle', 'tcp_keepalives_interval', 'tcp_keepalives_count', 'client_connection_check_interval') ORDER BY name

step6_memory_per_connection.desc: 估算连接占用的内存（work_mem * 并发排序 + 基础开销）
step6_memory_per_connection.sql: SELECT current_setting('work_mem') AS work_mem, current_setting('shared_buffers') AS shared_buffers, current_setting('max_connections') AS max_connections, pg_size_pretty(current_setting('work_mem')::bigint * 1024 * current_setting('max_connections')::int) AS max_work_mem_total

step7_superuser_reserved.desc: 确认超级用户保留连接是否可用
step7_superuser_reserved.sql: SELECT current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int AS reserved, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usename IN (SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolsuper)) AS superuser_connections FROM pg_stat_activity

step8_connection_wait_events.desc: 查看连接相关的等待事件
step8_connection_wait_events.sql: SELECT wait_event_type, wait_event, state, COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' GROUP BY wait_event_type, wait_event, state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20

emergency_playbook.scenario: FATAL: too many clients already — 新连接全部被拒绝

steps.action: 用超级用户连接查看当前连接分布（超级用户有保留连接）
steps.sql: SELECT usename, datname, state, COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY usename, datname, state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
steps.note: 使用 psql -U postgres 连接，超级用户可使用 superuser_reserved_connections 保留的连接槽

steps.action: 终止所有 idle 和 idle in transaction 连接释放槽位
steps.sql: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IN ('idle', 'idle in transaction') AND pid != pg_backend_pid() AND usename != 'replicator'
steps.risk: idle in transaction 的事务会被回滚

steps.action: 如果活跃连接也过多，终止非关键用户/应用的连接
steps.sql: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name IN ('{non_critical_app}') AND pid != pg_backend_pid()
steps.risk: 被终止的应用需要处理断连重连

steps.action: 临时增大 max_connections（如果内存允许）
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = 300; -- 需要重启生效
steps.risk: 重启数据库会断开所有现有连接
steps.note: 这是临时措施，根本解决方案是部署连接池

steps.action: 设置保护参数防止复发
steps.sql: ALTER SYSTEM SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '5min'; ALTER SYSTEM SET idle_session_timeout = '30min'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
steps.risk: 长连接应用可能受影响

version_specific_notes.12: 无 idle_session_timeout，仅有 idle_in_transaction_session_timeout。tcp_keepalives_* 参数用于检测死连接
version_specific_notes.13: 新增 idle_session_timeout 参数（非事务空闲超时）。pg_stat_activity 新增 leader_pid 字段追踪并行查询工作进程
version_specific_notes.14: pg_stat_database 新增 sessions、sessions_abandoned、sessions_fatal、sessions_killed 计数器。client_connection_check_interval 参数允许后端定期检查客户端连接是否仍存活
version_specific_notes.15: 新增 reserved_connections 参数（PG16 实际引入），允许为非超级用户角色保留连接。pg_stat_activity 改进
version_specific_notes.16: 新增 reserved_connections 参数。新增 pg_stat_io 包含后端 I/O 统计。改进连接认证性能
version_specific_notes.17: 连接管理内部优化，减少连接建立的开销。改进的并行查询连接管理。内置连接池（实验性功能）讨论中

real_world_examples.scenario: 微服务架构 30 个服务耗尽 200 个连接
real_world_examples.symptoms: 间歇性出现 FATAL: too many clients already，30 个微服务各配置 10 个连接池 = 300 个潜在连接
real_world_examples.root_cause: 每个微服务独立连接池，多数时候只用 1-2 个连接但预占了 10 个。同时有 idle in transaction 泄漏导致峰值时爆满
real_world_examples.resolution: 部署 PgBouncer（transaction 模式，default_pool_size=30），应用改连 PgBouncer。设置 idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=5min
real_world_examples.result: 数据库端连接数从峰值 200+ 降至稳定 25-35，再无连接耗尽问题

real_world_examples.scenario: PHP 短连接模式导致每秒 200 次 fork
real_world_examples.symptoms: CPU sys% 持续 15-20%，pg_stat_database 的 numbackends 在 50-150 间剧烈波动
real_world_examples.root_cause: PHP-FPM 每个请求创建新数据库连接，请求结束后断开。峰值期每秒 200 个连接创建/销毁
real_world_examples.resolution: 部署 PgBouncer 在 PHP 和 PostgreSQL 之间，max_client_conn=500，default_pool_size=20
real_world_examples.result: 数据库端连接稳定在 20 个，CPU sys% 降至 3%，PHP 请求延迟降低 40%
